name: Pour
purpose: Fill the chosen mould through an assisted, resumable virtual pour.
on_enter: Validate recipe and load the matching cavity/fill mesh, jug and stream system.
If fillSourceBodyRevision != bodyRevision, fillProgress=0. If these revisions match, restore partial fill even when filledBodyRevision is not yet set.
At 100%, enter filled state; do not replay a finished pour after reload.
on_exit: Stop flow/audio, checkpoint fill progress and revision; clear jug capture.
persistence: Persist fillProgress[0..1], fillSourceBodyRevision, filledBodyRevision, pourState safe restore marker and current bodyRevision. Debounce progress writes to 250ms and checkpoint explicit pause/transitions.
back_rule: Back 06 retains valid partial fill until recipe changes. Next 08 only at fill=1 and surface settling complete; filled state may wait indefinitely.
acceptance: One tap fully completes; no tilt sensor or exact drag is required.
Close/reopen during fill restores coherent partial progress.
No overflow or double-completion event on resume.
implementation_notes: Jug contents, stream tint and mould fill share recipe appearance; inside pieces share the recipe seed.
For foam, liquid-like magical fill transitions to matte foam at reveal; never suggest real chemical mixing.

actions.trigger: Tap jug/Pour; or assisted drag into target
actions.command: Set fillSourceBodyRevision=bodyRevision before first progress checkpoint. Align 300ms, ramp stream 200ms; increase fill over 2.7s for whole volume; clamp to 1; cutoff 300ms; settle 300ms
actions.state_write: Monotonic fill; at filled set filledBodyRevision=bodyRevision; event keyed draftId:bodyRevision:fill.
actions.feedback: Stream anchored at spout and surface; bounded ripples; one active pour loop.
actions.interrupt: Tap-start auto-pour continues after pointerup. Manual drag release pauses. pointercancel/page hide always pause both. This distinction prevents a tap cancelling itself.

actions.command: Pause immediately stops volume increase and stream/audio; Resume uses remaining volume
actions.feedback: Pause glyph becomes resume; partially filled mould remains.
actions.interrupt: Repeated toggles serialized; no additional start while aligning/cutoff.

actions.state_write: lastStep=08; do not award creation coins.
actions.interrupt: Guard failure highlights Pour, not a text-only error.
